prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Charlotte NC?
answer_verbatim:
If you mean **spray tanning**, **Organic Bronze Bar in SouthPark** looks like a strong pick: it specializes in all-natural spray tans and has a **4.9/5 rating from 126 reviews** on BestProsInTown. Customers also praise the technicians for helping them choose a natural-looking shade and making the appointment comfortable.

**Organic Bronze Bar — SouthPark**  
2907 Providence Rd, Suite 102A, Charlotte, NC 28211  
(980) 498-0008 · [Website](https://organicbronzebar.com/southpark/)

For a broader salon with tanning beds as well as spray tans, **Palm Beach Tan** is another option; its Park Towne Village location lists a 4.28/5 rating on its site. Ratings can vary by location, so check recent reviews and hours before you go.
